title: Butt-weld valve -> 2 welds
gap: takeOut() returns 0 for valve-bw, so the valve has no face-to-face body. Both incident edges therefore emit their weld at the same coordinate and W() merges them inside WELD_TOL (2 mm), leaving one weld where the fabrication rule calls for two. The fix is not to emit two welds at one point: the valve needs a real face-to-face length (ASME B16.10) so the two welds land at distinct positions and the valve body becomes an element that spool-splitting can see.
